text:
tanya: Following the midnight DB incident, sketched a 48h quick-closure plan to kill low-effort tails and surface recurrence signals. sharing here for rapid sign-off.

ajay: love it. can we force an explicit owner for every line item? reduces 'who's on it' back-and-forth.

maria: yep, i'll own the short-term breaker PR and smoke test. can push in the next 2h.

incident-bot: Task created: INC-4499 - 48h quick-closure checklist. Owners: maria, ajay, tanya. https://internal/tasks/INC-4499

lucas: I'll run the alert-pattern query for last 90d and post a tiny summary. if there's a cluster we should escalate to a 72h RCA slot.

ajay: proposed checklist (compact table style):
- triage remaining alerts | owner | ETA 2h | quick-verify: clear/no new alerts
- deploy short-term circuit-breaker | maria | ETA 4h | quick-verify: smoke-check pass
- update runbook section "DB transient spike" | tanya | ETA 8h | quick-verify: runbook link + test step
- schedule 72h RCA if recurrence | lucas | ETA 48h | quick-verify: RCA invite + agenda

tanya: i'll make that exact one-line tracker in the incident doc: "owner | ETA | verify-step | notes". keeps it scannable.

maria: PR: https://git/repo/patch4499 - includes breaker and `curl` smoke-check. reviewers pinged.

ajay: add a microscopic test in the runbook so oncall can validate without deep context: `curl -sS http://health/db-check | jq -r .status` -> expect "ok".

lucas: posted alert histogram: https://dash/alerts/DB-spike-90d - notable weekly pattern around batch windows, but not identical to last night. will annotate anomalies.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h check-in for INC-4499.

tanya: comms cadence proposal: 1) internal thread updates only for first 24h; 2) 24h brief to execs if mitigations incomplete; 3) public/customer comms only if SLA impact or repeated occurrence.

ajay: agree. minimize churn. also tag remediation-level (quick/medium/long) on each action so PMs can prioritize resource allocation.

maria: thumbs up. quick note: for the breaker, include a short rollback note so oncall can revert if it misfires.

lucas: taking the 72h recurrence check. will surface top 3 suspects + signal-to-noise by EOD tomorrow.

tanya: perfect. i'll create the tracker entry and link it: https://docs.redwood/incident/INC-4499/quick-closure

ajay: small ops improvement: incident doc should auto-expose tasks as a read-only checklist in the runbook so anyone can see progress without digging into tasks UI. filing infra request after this.

incident-bot: INC-4499 updated: owner statuses changed: maria(working), lucas(assigned), tanya(assigned).

maria: breaker deployed to canary cluster, smoke-check green. awaiting reviewer thumbs.

tanya: updated runbook with test step and rollback text. link in tracker.

ajay: nice. schedule a 24h alignment on this thread tomorrow at this time to confirm no recurrence. if none, we'll close the quick-closure and move medium/long actions to the PM queue.

lucas: noted. thanks team. this compact checklist format feels like the right balance between speed and accountability. :thumbsup:

tanya: closing loop for now 1 - tracker created, owners assigned, PR up, analytics running. re-open thread in 24h or earlier if anything pops.
